terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.draftNotice: This is a draft policy pending legal review. It is provided for transparency and will be finalized before public launch.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of terms
body: By creating an account or using AstroSaathi, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.

sections.heading: 2. What AstroSaathi is
body: AstroSaathi is an AI-powered Vedic astrology companion. Using the birth details you provide, we generate a kundli (birth chart) and let you chat with an AI astrologer that references your chart, planetary positions, dashas, and yogas to answer your questions.

sections.heading: 3. Eligibility
body: You must be at least 18 years old to use AstroSaathi, consistent with the age confirmation you provide during onboarding.

sections.heading: 4. Your account
body: You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for all activity under your account. Let us know right away if you suspect unauthorized access.

sections.heading: 5. Acceptable use
body: Use AstroSaathi respectfully. Do not attempt to misuse, disrupt, reverse-engineer, or abuse the service, or use it to generate harmful, illegal, or abusive content.

sections.heading: 6. Guidance is for reflection only
body: Astrological readings and AI chat replies are offered for reflection and self-understanding. They are not a substitute for professional medical, legal, or financial advice. Please consult a qualified professional for decisions in those areas.

sections.heading: 7. Your data
body: Our Privacy Policy explains what we collect and how it is used. You can delete your birth data, chat history, and account at any time from Settings.

sections.heading: 8. Intellectual property
body: The AstroSaathi app, design, and branding are owned by us. Chart data and AI responses are provided for your personal, non-commercial use.

sections.heading: 9. Termination
body: You may stop using AstroSaathi and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.

sections.heading: 10. Limitation of liability
body: AstroSaathi is provided "as is". We are not liable for decisions made based on astrological guidance, or for outcomes outside our reasonable control.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of AstroSaathi after changes take effect means you accept the updated terms.

sections.heading: 12. Contact
body: Questions about these terms? Reach out to us through the contact details in the app.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draftNotice: This is a draft policy pending legal review. It is provided for transparency and will be finalized before public launch.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
body: This policy explains what information AstroSaathi collects, how we use it, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: 2. Information we collect
body: Account details: your name and email address.
Birth details: date, time, and place of birth, used to generate your kundli.
Chat history: the messages you exchange with the AI astrologer, so replies can reference earlier conversation and, if you opt in, remember context across sessions.

sections.heading: 3. How we use your information
body: We use your birth details with astrology chart providers to calculate your kundli, planetary positions, dashas, and yogas.
We send your chart context and chat messages to AI providers to generate personalized astrologer replies.
If you opt in to memory during consent, we use past conversations to personalize future guidance. This is off by default and can be changed anytime in Settings.

sections.heading: 4. Where your data is stored
body: Your account, birth details, and chat history are stored in Supabase, encrypted in transit and at rest.

sections.heading: 5. Third-party providers
body: We share the minimum data needed with AI model providers and Vedic astrology chart providers solely to generate your readings and chat replies. We do not sell your personal data to anyone.

sections.heading: 6. Data retention
body: We retain your data for as long as your account is active, or until you delete it.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights and choices
body: You can review, update, or delete your birth details, chat history, and account at any time from Settings. Deleting your account removes your stored personal data from our systems.

sections.heading: 8. Children's privacy
body: AstroSaathi is not intended for anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect data from minors.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy from time to time. We will update the "last updated" date above when we do.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
body: Questions about this policy? Reach out to us through the contact details in the app.
